data.body: 2026-09-28, follow-up to task 150 (finished): the ask-question dialog is 660px wide, declared in desktop/src/chat/question.css as `.workbench-dialog.question-dialog { max-width: 660px }` — 1.5x the 440px it actually rendered at. Cascade trap worth remembering: task 150's `max-width: 520px` on the one-class `.question-dialog` never applied, because Vite bundles the base `.workbench-dialog` rule (max-width 440px, width calc(100% - 32px)) after question.css and an equal-specificity later rule wins; any per-dialog width override here must name both classes. The inherited `calc(100% - 32px)` still caps the dialog to the viewport. Measured against the production bundle in Firefox/geckodriver: 660px at 1400px viewport, 528px at 560px, no horizontal overflow. tsc --noEmit clean, vitest src/chat 230 passed, vite build ok; no test or mockup asserts this width. 1.5x of the authored 520px would have been 780px.
